ns2:course.label: Basic Leadership
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of military and USGS map reading including methods such as intersection and resection; includes land navigation and orienteering techniques and their application. Includes field trip. Prerequisite: Only available to students who have less than 60 credit hours.
